candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion at the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle connections and fail with DependencyUnavailable after ~2s, causing order POST 503 and gateway checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side pool metrics or saturation counters; pool exhaustion inferred from idle=0 and DependencyUnavailable, not directly measured.

report.explanation: All failing checkout traces converge on postgres.save_order: pool size 5, idle 0, ~2s then DependencyUnavailable, propagating to order 503 and gateway 502. Inventory and payment succeed. Consistent with db-pool-exhaustion; postgres-side pool metrics would confirm.
